projects.title: Event Marketplace
projects.description: A Java Swing desktop application for university event management, ticket purchasing, and QR-based ticket scanning.

projects.title: Receipt Scanner
projects.description: A Streamlit web application that uses the Gemini 2.5 Flash model to extract receipt data and automatically populate an editable web form.

projects.title: Parking Lot Management System
projects.description: A Java Swing desktop application featuring a custom GUI for tracking revenue/occupancy, visualizing data flow, and managing unpaid fines.

projects.title: Multiplayer Hybrid Concurrency Game
projects.description: A concurrent C logging system featuring atomic updates and signal handling to ensure thread-safe data persistence and game scoring.

projects.title: Robot Battlefield Simulator
projects.description: A C++ grid-based simulation application featuring class inheritance for specialized robots, a custom battlefield manager, and a turn execution engine for movement validation.

projects.title: Hostel Management System (HORECA)
projects.description: A web-based maintenance management system for tracking hostel damages and providing automated email notifications to complainants and administrators.

projects.title: Ramadan Guide
projects.description: A collaborative frontend website with integrated Google Maps that allows users to select from a pre-defined list of mosques to easily view distances and get directions from their location.

projects.title: Seminar Management System
projects.description: A role-based Java Swing application featuring a three-tier architecture for automated academic grading, student filtering, and flat-file data persistence.

aboutpara: A dedicated Software Engineering student with experience in software testing and development. Focused on building reliable systems using PHP and C++, supported by intermediate certifications and hands-on internship experience. Successfully applied design patterns and concurrency models to complex academic projects. Committed to continuous self-improvement, solving technical problems and collaborating in diverse team environments. Trilingual in Malay, English and German.

resume.tagline: I am a Software Engineering student who is passionate about design and quality assurance
resume.description: I believe that technology should be accessible and impactful. My primary goal is to develop intuitive systems that simplify and improve people's daily lives.

bullets: Full-Stack Development & Design Integration: Spearheaded the end-to-end development of administrative modules across 5 diverse projects, successfully translating complex Figma prototypes into functional, responsive front-end interfaces using PHP.

Live System Maintenance & Optimization: Entrusted with the maintenance of a high-traffic, live production system, proactively debugged client-reported issues, deployed new feature enhancements, and ensured 100% system uptime.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated high adaptability by supporting multiple development teams, contributing to rapid feature deployment and rigorous testing phases to ensure project deliverables met client specifications and documentation standards.
